authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 138-120 (even side, 1895), 2024-12-11 overcast strip. 126-138 is one BAG pand of seven street modules: 138 and 134-130 plain brick with flat heads and white pediment dormers, 126-128 a symmetric front with two pointed street gables over round-headed end axes and two dormers between, a timber shopfront with dark piers across. 122 and 120: 3-axis plain brick with pediment dormers. All on kinker-1890-plain-brick by eye (the cluster put 126-138 and 120 on kinker-1902-balcony-axis, NCC 0.22/0.35: there are no balconies).
